description: Unofficial fan art of Kirisame Marisa from Touhou Project. A modest black-and-white cel-animation adaptation with one anatomical-left braid, toy-jar lid recovery, three-paper-star sweeping and moon-disc inspection. Toy broom appears in selected states; leftward and frontward steps are prop-free for clear articulated gait. Props and choreography are original, not official animations.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
